title: Eddoboozi ly'Okujeemera
intro: Edda ennyo ng’omuntu eyasooka tannatambula ku nsi, ekitonde eky’amaanyi amangi ennyo kyali kiyimiridde mu kifo eky’emirembe ekituukiridde, nga kyetooloddwa emyoyo egyali gisinga okwewaayo. Ekiragiro kimu bwe kyaweebwa, buli ddoboozi lyafukamiranga mu kugondera —naye eddoboozi limu lyasituka nga lijeemera, era okujeemera okwo kwandiwulikika mu buli mulembe okutuusa ku Lunaku olwasembayo. Kino ekitonde ekigudde y’ani?
clues: Nnatondebwa okuva mu kintu ekyayaka ennyo, ate abalala ku mabbali gange ne batondebwa okuva mu bye batambulirako.
Nabeera mu kifo ekitukuvu mu bitonde ebyewaddeyo, okutuusa ekiragiro kimu lwe kyakyusa buli kimu.
Ekiragiro bwe kyatuuka, buli mmeeme yavunnama okuggyako nze; okugaana kwange kwazaalibwa amalala.
Nnagobwa okuva mu kifo ekyo ekitukuvu, nga nfunye ekikolimo ekigenda okuwangaala emirembe gyonna.
Nasabiriza ekiseera okutuusa ku lunaku lw’amazuukira, ne kikkirizibwa. Nalayira okusemberera buli mwoyo ne mbabuzaabuza.
Ekkondeere bwe linaavuga, abaangoberera bajja kugabana enkomerero yange, nga banneegattako mu muliro oguyaka ennyo nga tewali muyambi ayinza kubawonya.

trial.label: Akaseera Akategeeza
options: Okugaana okuvunnama mu maaso ga Adamu
Okukola olukwe lw’okusuula omutuukirivu mu muliro
Okukulembera abantu okusinza ekifaananyi ekya zaabu
trial.answer: Okugaana okuvunnama mu maaso ga Adamu

location.label: Ekifo Ekitukuvu
options: Olubiri olulungi ennyo ku mugga Kiyira
Ennyana eya zaabu eyakolebwa okuva mu by’okwewunda

outcome.label: Enkomerero Esembayo
options: Gobwa ebweru, n’okuwummula okutuusa ku Lunaku olwasuubizibwa
Yabbira mu mazzi n’amagye wansi w’amayengo
Yamenya amayinja agaakubwa okuva mu bbanga
outcome.answer: Gobwa ebweru, n’okuwummula okutuusa ku Lunaku olwasuubizibwa

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
